intro: Reborn isn’t just a mattress—it’s a fresh start. With supportive layers and sustainable materials, it helps you wake up feeling balanced, recharged, and ready to take on the day.

features.title: Care for yourself and the planet
features.text: Your comfort shouldn’t cost the planet. Crafted from sustainable materials, our mattress keeps you cosy while supporting a greener future.

features.title: Designed to support your back with care
features.text: Wake up refreshed—our mattress contours to align your body properly, easing pressure for healthier sleep.

features.title: Cool comfort with breathable fabric
features.text: Our built-in airflow channels enhance ventilation throughout your mattress, helping regulate temperature and moisture for a fresher, more comfortable sleep every night.

features.title: Dense foam core for lasting support
features.text: Reliable firm support keeps your mattress in shape for years, giving you consistent comfort night after night.

features.title: Safe sleep with hypoallergenic cover
features.text: Allergy concerns shouldn’t get in the way of good sleep. Our thoughtfully designed materials promote cleaner air and a healthier, more restful sleeping environment.

features.title: Tailored sizing for any bed frame
features.text: Our customisable dimensions make it easy to achieve a perfect fit for beds of all shapes and sizes.

name: Reborn Single Bed Foam Mattress 78 X 36 X 6 Inches
